details.notes: At last. A game that Motherwell have controlled and looked close to comfortable, for the majority of play.  Many commentators praised the team for commited and progressive play, with the manager saying he'd rather they made mistake for being to adventurous than from sitting back and being safe.  An easy tap in for Stamatelopoulos and a double for Maswanhise - his second goal was an absolute SCREAMER.  If this is the way we can play against one of the first 'proper' teams we've faced, then we should be in good shape for the season ahead. Let's just hope its a taste of things to come under our new manager.  #COYW!!
Third painful game in a row. Weather played a big part in the match, as well as the tattie field they called a pitch. Write it up as a win, but nothing to celebrate on the road back home.  #COYW!!

Another nervy performance from a team clearly finding it's way through the game. The Longelo goal was a screamer and gives me hope for better things to come. But we can only pray this is pre-season jitters and the team will come good in the league.  #COYW!!
Far from convincing, slightly worrying to be fair. To get the bonus point and win penalties is good, but should never have needed to take that long. #COYW!!
